objective: Complete Phase 9 C13 as shaped in odd/tasks/phase9-c13-inception-family.md: align the five existing custom inception skills with the delivered ODD role contracts while preserving historical identities and measurement invariants.
scope: Specs S1-S9 and tasks T1-T8 of odd/tasks/phase9-c13-inception-family.md. One task is opened at a time. The five skill IDs are inception-pipeline, project-inception, project-manifest, project-architect, and roadmap-maker.
runtime_scope: Parent-coordinated bounded Codex/OpenAI roles and the existing native Labdrian management CLI. This work does not implement or claim Hermes runtime integration.
delivery_boundary: Local task-scoped edits and verification in feat/phase9-c13-inception. Commits, remote publication, merges and deployment require separate owner authorization. Human skill approvals remain human operations after final content stabilizes.
constraints: Implement only a task with a valid shaper design mark and the exact paths it authorizes.
Observe the named safety net and meaningful RED before changing behavior; preserve failures and use the same test through GREEN.
Use Codex/OpenAI for all real model calls; do not launch Claude or Anthropic actors.
Preserve existing topic identities, actuals schemas, anchor semantics, historical evidence and all unrelated edits.
Use isolated test state and existing toolchains; no live configuration, approval-record fabrication, deployment or package installation.
New memory persistence uses memorycard; legacy Engram evidence remains read-only and no memorycard sync support is inferred.
An unresolved consequential product decision blocks only its affected work and returns to the owner.
non_goals: C22-FU memorycard sync or migration implementation.
A new runtime, orchestration framework, runner, schema migration or review benchmark.
Changing generated role agents or approving skills on the owner's behalf.
acceptance_criteria: Each shaped task has observed results and retained limitations in the feature document; unexecuted work is not marked complete.
The public role-verb regression proves the documented feature-doc handoff and preserves malformed and ambiguous-example rejection.
Closure and producer instructions use the current ODD artifacts while preserving the named actuals and historical-anchor invariants.
All five rewritten skills satisfy the existing lint contract and carry fresh actual human approvals before C16 is considered satisfied for them.
The named focused, regression and independent checks are executed and reported accurately; no unrun check is treated as a pass.
